title: Quick Toggle Sneak
description: Quickly toggle sneak with a keybind!
body:
# Quick Toggle Sneak
So, I was bored. And... I decided to make the best way to toggle sneak!

## Usage
Just press I to toggle sneak! The easiest way to do it, to be honest.
## Credits
Me. I was literally the only one bored enough to do it.
## Support
How can anyone need support for this? This is the most simple way to toggle sneak.. But if you really need it, join my Discord!
### Hope you enjoy!
